text:
maria: Heads-up — we need to finalize the routing + quota behavior for requests that lose origin claims in the auth gateway. Console is showing weird double-charges and the per-project SLO widget is spiking. :eyes:
raj: Is this API key traffic or service-account tokens? Any repro steps?
maria: Mostly service-account tokens routed through the proxy/exchange path. Repro: client->proxy (adds X-Origin-Project)->auth-gateway; sometimes X-Origin is stripped and downstream sees no project claim, so it falls to the global quota bucket.
lee: Confirmed — this matches the forwarding rule where the exchange strips unknown headers for safety. I filed a tiny fix last week but it depends on the canary gating.
jess: If we rely on token introspection to recover claims we add ~15-25ms. That's okay for batch/async, not for low-latency routes. Do we want introspect as fallback?
maria: Prefer minimal perf hit. Proposal: 1) try to preserve X-Origin header in proxy (cheap) 2) if missing, do a single introspect call but only when quota attribution would change project vs global (i.e., potentially bill different owner)
oliver: From telemetry side, current dashboards collapse these into "unknown" which makes debugging harder. We should add a metric tag like fallback_reason=header_missing|introspected so we can filter.
raj: I like that. Concrete rollout plan: a) add fallback_reason tag to request metrics b) quick proxy patch to stop stripping X-Origin c) enable selective introspect fallback behind a feature flag d) UI flag in console to surface fallback counts per route/project
jess: UX note on console: default the flag OFF for GA, show a tooltip: "Requests without origin claims may be conservatively attributed to global quota; enable fallback attribution to introspect and attribute to projects (may increase latency)."
lee: I'll open the proxy PR for header-preserve today and mark it opt-in. PR: <https://github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/987> — small change + unit. Canary it to staging.
sre-bot: canary deploy: auth-gateway v2.3.1 -> us-west-2 finished (status: success) :white_check_mark:
maria: Great. Raj, can you update the runbook and add a dashboard card showing fallback_reason and rate of introspection? If fallback > 0.5% for 24h -> page oncall.
raj: Yep — I'll create a console ticket and link the metrics query.
jess: Once we have metrics, let's A/B the introspect fallback on 2% of traffic and measure p95 latency + attribution accuracy for a day.
maria: Sounds good. I'll coordinate the rollout plan with product and mark the console change as opt-in behind an admin toggle. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
